shard_defaults_contract.inheritance: A shard-level defaults object is merged into each company record before validation. Company-local fields override inherited fields.
shard_defaults_contract.consumer_rule: Consumers must resolve defaults before displaying or exporting a company dossier.

classification_notes.l1_private_experiment_boundary: An L1 PRIVATE_EXPERIMENT with ORIGINAL_CANDIDATE provenance is an owner-estate or direct-name discovery that has not received semantic source, originality, or runnable-proof verification. ORIGINAL_CANDIDATE means candidate provenance, not verified authorship. These records remain excluded from recruiter surfaces until evidence supports promotion to L2 or higher.
classification_notes.legacy_promotion_alias_boundary: UPSTREAM_OR_SAMPLE is retained only as a raw migration alias in one legacy row and resolves to EXCLUDED_AUTHORSHIP before validation or consumption. It remains a provenance value on the separate provenance axis and is never a recruiter admission state.

truth_boundary.coverage: All 67 Helix inventory entries must map. Direct-named discoveries for enumerated families are included. Semantic relevance across the 1,165+ estate remains continuing review and is not falsely claimed complete.

level_definitions.L5: FLAGSHIP_AUTHORITY: original reusable system with current executable proof and senior-level depth.
level_definitions.L4: ADVANCED_SYSTEM: substantial original system or suite with strong architecture and meaningful verification; some gates remain.
level_definitions.L3: FOCUSED_PROTOTYPE: distinct bounded exhibit needing stronger current tests, hardware, provider, or deployment evidence.
level_definitions.L2: REFERENCE_ARCHITECTURE: doctrine, concept, private architecture, or integration candidate; not executable recruiter proof.
level_definitions.L1: STUDY_OR_UPSTREAM: upstream/sample/mirror/fork/study or unverified owner-estate experiment; never recruiter authorship proof without promotion evidence.
level_definitions.L0: QUARANTINED: unsafe, sensitive, misleading, duplicate-unresolved, or materially failing.
